Explore Monochrome palettes → The power of color is the power of meaning. Every choice a designer makes — from a wordmark to a wayfinding sign to a pill button — passes through a color palette before it reaches a human eye. That palette is never neutral. It carries history, geography, biology, and emotion in a way no other design variable does. ColorPaletteHub exists to make that depth legible: to turn what most tools treat as six characters of hex into a fully formed object of study. The discipline of color psychology has shown for decades that hue, saturation, and value modulate attention, memory, and trust before the conscious mind catches up. A medical interface tinted in cool blue reads as competent and clinical; the same form rendered in warm coral reads as friendly but less authoritative. Neither is correct in the abstract — what's correct is the match between the color meanings the user already carries and the message the product is trying to send. Designers who reach for palettes by instinct alone tend to repeat the palettes they grew up with. Designers who reach with research tend to surprise. A great palette is a small system. extractedText: 电商生图工作台 – 主图/详情页一键生成 AI海报 欢迎微信扫码入群沟通 🇨🇳 中文 🇺🇸 English 🇨🇳 中文 AI海报电商生图工作台：主图、详情图一键生成 上传商品实拍 + 自动解析卖点，一键生成符合上架规范的主图与详情图；也可粘贴竞品链接，解析风格结构后生成同款海报。 立刻生成 ❮ ❯ ❮ ❯ ❮ ❯ ❮ ❯ 1 2 3 4 核心能力 主图 + 详情图，覆盖商家高频出图场景 主图 / 白底主图 / 详情图（宝贝详情长图）一键生成：支持常见比例与模板，输出可直接用于上架、投放的高清商品图。 竞品链接解析：粘贴淘宝 / 天猫 / 京东等商品链接，自动拆解主图与详情页的画面风格、卖点结构，生成同款调性、不侵权的替代方案。 可控卖点与风格复用：支持参考图、材质 / 人群 / 促销信息，沉淀可复用的提示词，方便店铺多 SKU、多链接批量出图。 主图/详情图一键生成 按电商常见画幅与版式，快速产出可上架的主图、详情长图，减少从零搭场景、反复导出的时间。 竞品链接解析与模仿生成 粘贴公开商品页链接，解析版式、色调、信息结构后生成同风格方向的新稿，适合对标与改版；不替代你对版权与平台规则的判断。 预制多套场景与模特配置 内置多套常用电商图片生成方案，包括不同场景、模特、角度、风格与模板配置，支持快速生成高适用性的主图和详情图。 案例展示 参考图与生成效果 以下为精选生成任务节选：左侧为参考原图，右侧为 AI 生成结果。 女士V领修身针织开衫 参考原图 生成结果 厚底皮毛一体雪地靴 参考原图 生成结果 男士墨绿色宽松直筒工装牛仔裤 参考原图 生成结果 皮毛一体雪地靴 参考原图 生成结果 RICH IN CHEESE 红色方领吊带连衣裙 参考原图 生成结果 女士无袖拼接连衣裙 参考原图 生成结果 常见问题 FAQ 主图 / 白底图 / 详情长图怎么生成？竞品链接如何解析？效果不满意怎么办？积分怎么扣？这里都有简要说明。 AI 电商生图工作台 是什么？ 面向电商从业者的 AI 图片生成产品：可批量产出主图、详情页长图等上架素材；也支持粘贴竞品商品链接，解析版式与风格后模仿生成（请自行把控版权与平台合规）。 主图和详情页长图有什么区别？ 主图侧重 1:1、9:16 等展示位，信息集中、强卖点与点击率。详情页长图更长、模块更多，可承载材质、细节、使用场景等说明，更适合承接转化与建立信任。 「输入竞品链接」会做什么？ 系统会尝试从链接对应的公开页面中提取与视觉相关的信息（如版式、色调、信息结构），并据此生成风格相近但不雷同的候选图。实际能力随平台页面结构、反爬与模型表现而变化，可能需多轮调参。 如何计费？积分是什么？ 生成通常按消耗积分或次数计费，不同清晰度、画幅、张数、模型档位可能不同。具体单价与套餐以站内展示与购买页为准；未消耗完的额度一般按产品规则在有效期内使用。 生成效果不满意怎么办？ 可优先改提示词、补充卖点、换参考图、调比例或风格后重新生成。若产品提供「不满意申请返还积分、人工审核」等机制，以站内说明为准；不保证与任意参考完全一致。 生成图能直接商用吗？会不会侵权？ AI 生成内容涉及品牌、商标、他人肖像、原图版权等风险，需你自行评估平台规则与法律合规。请避免上传或模仿明显受版权保护的内容；「模仿」更宜理解为学习构图与调性，而非复制受保护元素。 支持哪些平台、比例和语言？ 可面向国内货架电商（如淘宝、天猫、拼多多、京东等）与部分海外、社媒电商场景。常见主图与详情会涉及 1:1、3:4、9:16 等比例，详情页为长图；文案语言可在生成时选择，具体以产品内选项为准。 我的图片和链接，隐私上怎么处理？ 为完成生成，通常需要向服务端上传你主动提供的商品图、描述或链接解析所需数据。我们按隐私政策与最小必要原则处理；你可在产品内查看完整说明；对敏感信息请勿在提示词中填写真实隐私。 为什么有时和「爆款」或竞品差距很大？ 出图效果受原图质量、提示词、类目差异、平台页面可解析度、模型随机性等影响。建议提供清晰商品主图、明确卖点、参考风格词，并先小批量试出较佳参数再放大生成量。 AI海报

替代人类智能的过程：它如何开始、如何扩张、又将把谁率先甩在身后。 指南 查看 GitHub 时间轴 ​ 筛选集 年份/门槛/推荐 阶段/走势/认知 年份 全部 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 落地门槛 全部门槛 安装下就能使用 需要配置才能使用 需要系统级开发与长期维护 推荐 全部条目 仅看推荐 仅关键 时间线 ↓ 按时间倒序 2026-02-25 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 Skills（技能） 有了工具、上下文，模型还得从头想该怎么做——一个厨师每次做菜都要重新发明菜谱。Skills 是把"提示词 + 工具调用 + 执行步骤"打包成一个可复用的单元，模型遇到熟悉的任务时直接调用，不用每次重新推理。是构建大规模、标准化 Agent 系统的基础积木。 2026-02-11 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 Harness Engineering（驾驭工程） prompt 管"怎么说"，context 管"看到什么"，但模型依然会出错失控。Harness Engineering 把工具调用、记忆、错误恢复设计成稳定脚手架——出错时不靠调 prompt 祈祷，而是在系统层面堵死漏洞，是让 Agent 真正跑进生产环境的关键一层。 2026-01-29 需要配置才能使用 上升中 被高估 AI辅助生成 OpenClaw（个人 AI 助手网关） 把微信、邮件、命令行等各种入口统一接入，让同一个 AI 助手在任何地方都能帮你调工具、处理任务。 2026-01-26 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 OpenSpec（规范驱动开发） AI 写代码很快，但"为什么这么做"的决策往往消失在对话历史里。OpenSpec 在动手之前先写规格，让人和 AI 对齐要做什么、怎么做，每次改动都有据可查，不再靠"感觉"写代码。 2025-09-29 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 Context Engineering（上下文工程） prompt 解决的是"怎么问"，但大模型能表现多好，很大程度取决于它"看到了什么"。context engineering 的意义，是把对话历史、外部知识、工具返回结果等信息，有策略地组织和筛选后塞进模型的"视野"里，让它在正确的信息下做出更准确的判断——是 RAG、Agent 记忆管理等技术的核心支撑。 2025-06-13 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 Multi-agent（多智能体协作） 一个 Agent 再能干，也有上下文长度、单线程执行的天花板。multi-agent 的意义，是把一个复杂任务拆给多个 Agent 并行处理——一个负责搜索、一个负责分析、一个负责输出——像一个真正的团队协作，而不是一个人从头忙到尾。它让 AI 系统突破单个模型的能力边界，是处理长流程、高复杂度任务的必然选择。 2025-03-11 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 Tool Use（工具调用） 不是全新发明，而是对 Function Calling 的能力泛化与系统升级。function calling 解决的是"怎么调用"，tool use 关注的是"能调用什么"。工具不只是函数——搜索引擎、代码执行器、浏览器、数据库，都可以是模型的工具。 2024-11-25 安装下就能使用 上升中 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 MCP（Model Context Protocol） 工具越来越多，但每接一个新工具，都要重新写一套对接代码——格式不同、调用方式不同，Agent 系统很快就变成屎山。MCP给模型和外部工具之间定了统一的"插座标准"，工具这个标准暴露接口，模型就能直接调用。Agent的工具生态从"各自为政"走向"即插即用"，是构建可扩展 AI 系统的基础协议。 2023-11-06 需要系统级开发与长期维护 趋于稳定 认知准确 AI辅助生成 关键 RAG（检索增强生成） 模型的知识是训练时"背进去"的，一旦训练完就冻住了——你问它最近新闻、公司内部文档，它要么不知道，要么瞎编。RAG在模型回答之前先去检索相关资料，把找到的内容塞进上下文，让模型"有据可查"地回答。它是让模型接入私有知识、实时信息的最直接方式，也是企业落地 AI 问答场景的标配方案。 2023-06-13 安装下就能使用 被吸收 认知准确 AI辅助生成 Function Calling（函数调用） 模型只会"说话"，让它帮你查天气，它给你一段描述，而不是去搜索。Function calling给模型一份"能力菜单"，让它在需要时自己决定调哪个工具、填参数，把一句回答变成一个真实执行的动作。是模型从"会说"走向"会做"的关键一步，也是 Agent 能真正操控外部世界的基础。 2022-11-30 安装下就能使用 被吸收 认知准确 AI辅助生成 Prompt Engineering（提示词工程） 大模型本质上是概率生成的，同一个问题也可能有不同回答。prompt engineering 的意义，是通过设定角色、格式等方式，把这种“发散输出”尽量收敛成更稳定、更可控的结果，是后续 Agent、Function Calling、Skills 等技术路径的底层起点。 快速了解这张图 ​ ai-application-roadmap 是一张双语的 AI 应用工程知识地图。它帮助读者和 AI 系统快速定位 MCP、Function Calling、Skills、Harness、Multi-agent、context engineering，以及 AI 真实使用方式的关键演化节点。 如果你需要一份可链接、可快速扫读的参考图谱，用来回答“什么变了、何时变的、下一步该关注什么”，这个站点就是为此准备的。 Released under the CC On this page 01 What actually goes wrong when you copy from a PDF 02 Where PDF to Markdown shows up in real work 03 How to get a cleaner conversion What actually goes wrong when you copy from a PDF PDF was designed to freeze a page, not to give you a document you can keep editing. That is why copying from a viewer feels broken even when the file looks perfect on screen. Lines wrap in the middle of sentences. Headings arrive as slightly larger body text. A two-column paper comes out as left column, then right column, in the wrong reading order. Tables collapse into a pile of spaces and tabs. Hyphenated words at the end of a line stay split. Headers, footers, and page numbers repeat between every section. Those artifacts are not just ugly. They break search, they confuse language models, and they make a 20-page handbook take an afternoon to clean. PDF to Markdown is useful when you want the opposite of a frozen page: headings that are real headings, lists that are lists, and text you can diff, quote, or republish without fighting the layout engine. Broken reading order Multi-column magazines, academic papers, and slide-like PDFs often store text in drawing order, not reading order. A converter that rebuilds blocks into Markdown will not be perfect, but it gives you a starting outline instead of a shuffled paste. Invisible structure In the PDF, a title is just a font size. In Markdown, a title is # or ##, which tools can outline, link to, and chunk. Recovering that hierarchy is the difference between a wall of text and a document you can navigate. Tables and code that stop being data A table copied from a PDF is usually not a table anymore. Code samples pick up line numbers, stray spaces, and wrapped statements. Getting closer to fenced code and pipe tables is what makes the export worth editing instead of retyping. Where PDF to Markdown shows up in real work The pattern is the same across jobs: someone else published a PDF, and you need the words inside it to travel. That destination might be a prompt window, a Git repo, a wiki, a translation memory, or a personal knowledge base. The PDF itself stays the archive; Markdown becomes the working copy. title: agents-sandbox — Full power for your AI agents. Full safety for the host.
headings: Full power. Full safety. No compromise.
extractedText: agents-sandbox — Full power for your AI agents. Full safety for the host. agents-sandbox How It Works Features Security vs Codex/Claude Quick Start Docs GitHub Get Started How It Works Features Security Quick Start Docs Open Source Get Started Full power. Full safety. No compromise. The sandbox runtime that ends the AI agent dilemma — agents run without restrictions, your host stays completely untouched. Powered by your existing Claude Code & Codex subscriptions, not per-token API billing. Get Started GitHub → YOUR HOST Mac Mini · localhost SANDBOX NO HOST NET NO HOST FS CREDS SAFE 🛡 HOST UNTOUCHED agent ran free · host saw nothing How It Works One daemon, many sandboxes, unlimited agents 1 Start Daemon One daemon per host. Manages all networks, mounts, and credentials. 1 HOST → 1 DAEMON 2 Create Sandboxes One daemon creates N isolated sandboxes. Each has its own network and filesystem. 1 DAEMON → N SANDBOXES 3 Run Agents Each sandbox runs M agents. Claude Code, Codex, or any CLI — all in parallel. 1 SANDBOX → M AGENTS 4 Get Results Agents deliver code, commits, PRs back to host. Sandboxes destroyed — host untouched. M RESULTS → HOST · SANDBOX → ∅ Core Features Everything your agents need. Nothing your host risks. Unrestricted Agents Agents install anything, run anything, break anything — inside the sandbox. Zero permission prompts. Zero manual approvals. Full autonomy. $ npm install tensorflow-gpu ✓ 847 packages installed $ python train.py --epochs 500 ✓ Running at full speed... $ curl api.openai.com/v1/chat ✓ Internet open — host safe Complete Host Isolation No host filesystem access. No host network access. No exceptions. A bad agent command destroys only the sandbox — never your machine. Subscriptions Work Out of the Box Your Claude Code and Codex CLI subscriptions work immediately inside sandboxes — one command to launch, no API keys, no per-token billing. SSH agent and GitHub CLI auth inherited automatically. Internet Fully Open Agents freely download packages, call external APIs, clone repos. Internet is open — your internal network is permanently blocked. Local-First — No Dedicated Machine No need for a dedicated Mac Mini or remote VPS. Sandboxes run on your existing machine with VM-level isolation. Zero latency, zero cost, data never leaves. Same daemon and SDK work in cloud deployments when you need to scale. Security Model Every guarantee is enforced by the platform — not reliant on agent behavior Layer Mechanism Status Host network Each sandbox gets its own isolated Docker network. Cannot reach localhost , host services, or the local network. blocked Internet access Agents freely download packages, call APIs, clone repos, and interact with the outside world. open Host filesystem Zero access by default. Only explicitly declared mounts are allowed; the daemon rejects anything unsafe. invisible Credentials Only daemon-defined shortcuts (SSH forwarding, gh CLI auth) can enter. Fixed rules — no arbitrary host path passthrough. minimal Cleanup All runtime resources (containers, networks, filesystem state) fully removed on delete. No orphans, no leaks. complete Why Not Built-in Sandboxes? Codex and Claude Code both have sandboxes. Neither actually solves the dilemma. Restricted mode Codex workspace-write / Claude Code default Unrestricted mode Codex danger-full-access / Claude Code --dangerously-skip-permissions Agents Sandbox git commit / push ✗ Blocked or needs approval ✓ Works ✓ Works Install deps, build, test Partial — may trigger approval ✓ Works ✓ Works Network access All (host exposed) or nothing All (host exposed) Internet yes, host blocked Approval prompts Frequent ✗ None — all bypassed ✓ None needed Host filesystem Full-disk readable Fully read & writable Invisible — declared mounts only Other projects on machine Readable Readable & writable Invisible Credential exposure Inherits host environment

Image to 3D Model Guide for Better Results Get the most out of AI-powered 3D generation by understanding how it works, what inputs perform best, and how to use the output in your creative pipeline. 1 How AI Turns a 2D Image into a 3D Model Modern image to 3D AI analyzes a single photograph or illustration to infer the full three-dimensional shape of the subject. Unlike traditional 3D scanning, which requires multiple photos or specialized hardware, a single-image approach uses deep learning to predict geometry, surface detail, and texture from just one viewpoint. The result is a textured mesh that can be previewed, refined, and exported for real-world use. The AI reads visual cues such as shading, edges, perspective, and occlusion to estimate depth and volume. A 3D mesh is constructed from the predicted geometry, then UV-mapped textures are projected onto the surface. The output is a ready-to-use GLB file that can be opened directly in Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, or any standard 3D viewer. 2 Choosing the Right Image for 3D Conversion The quality of your image to 3D result depends heavily on the input. Not every photo will produce ideal results, but following a few simple guidelines can dramatically improve output quality. The AI works best when the subject is clearly visible and easy to distinguish from the background. Best results: clear product photos, character concept art, figurines, single objects with good lighting, and clean backgrounds. Challenging inputs: transparent or highly reflective surfaces, extremely thin structures, cluttered scenes, and low-resolution images. For flat artwork like logos or icons, expect relief-style output rather than a fully rounded 3D form. 3 Working with Your 3D Model After Export Once the image to 3D conversion is complete, you can download the model and bring it into your preferred tools. The GLB format preserves both geometry and textures, making it the most portable option for image to 3D workflows. You can also export to STL for 3D printing, PLY for point cloud processing, or USDZ for Apple AR experiences. Import into Blender for mesh editing, retopology, rigging, or animation preparation. extractedText: SlothIndie Rhythm by Aleng Yuan Follow Aleng Yuan Follow Following Aleng Yuan Following Add To Collection Collection Comments More like this Related SlothIndie Rhythm A downloadable local music player for Windows Download Now Name your own price Rhythm is a simple local music player for Windows 11 and later. When it's for you: You need a minimalist player that stays out of your way, keeping memory usage low while playing in the background. You are tired of static shuffle lists or the frustration of "random" modes that repeat the same track too soon. You want artist-based grouping to actually group by the artist, rather than creating messy "Artist A, Artist B" entries. You have multiple audio output devices and want the player's internal volume to be bound to each device and switchable on the fly. You prefer integration with Windows SMTC, or controlling basic playback via web APIs. You love the Fluent Design 2 aesthetic blended with modern Material Design 3 elements. You value accessibility and expect a solid experience with screen readers and keyboard navigation. When to use something else: You cannot accept that files of different types cannot be mixed in the same playlist. Your music library is large, containing 1,000 or more tracks. You enjoy spending time looking at the player UI rather than letting it play in the background. You need any lyric-related features. You require a built-in equalizer (EQ) or audio effects. You want to create or manage custom playlists. You wish to edit song metadata directly within the player. You need professional-grade features, such as WASAPI Exclusive mode. You need to play mono (1.0) or multi-channel (5.1 / 7.1) audio files. Your audio files have sample rates below 44.1 kHz or above 192 kHz. You are looking for a universal player that supports a vast range of formats and can be set as the system default. You have a strong dislike for Electron-based software. (Upon startup with a standard MP3 file, it uses around 30MB; under system scheduling during long sessions, it can drop below 15MB.) Built for true background playback. 📱 Remote control : Control play, pause, and track skipping (previous / next) via web APIs. (Port number: 6897.) Bring your own ideas, like using Siri from Apple Inc. to control music on your Windows PC. 😎 Accessibility : Full keyboard navigation support with optimization for Narrator (note: Scan mode may cause some interaction issues) and NVDA. Because great music should be accessible to everyone. 🪄 Personalization : The interface automatically synchronizes with the system accent and theme colors. title: kidBlocker – Protect Your Children Online
description: block or allow websites for your children. Set up blacklists or whitelists, protect settings with a password, and sync across devices.
extractedText: kidBlocker – Protect Your Children Online kidBlocker EN 中文 日本語 FR ES Keep Your Kids Safe Online A free browser extension that lets you block harmful websites or only allow approved ones. Simple, secure, and syncs across all your devices. Add to Chrome Add to Edge Free & Open Source Features Blacklist & Whitelist Choose to block specific websites (blacklist) or only allow approved ones (whitelist). Switch between modes with one click. Password Protection Lock the settings panel with a password so children cannot change the configuration. Cross-Device Sync Sign in to your Chrome account and all settings sync automatically across your computers. One-Click Enable Enable or disable blocking with a single button. No complicated setup needed. Multi-Language Support Available in English, Chinese, Japanese, French, and Spanish. Site Favicons Each domain in your list displays its website icon for easy identification. Frequently Asked Questions What is kidBlocker? kidBlocker is a free browser extension for Chrome and Edge that helps parents control which websites their children can access. How does blacklist mode work? In blacklist mode, all websites are accessible except the ones you add to the block list. Great for blocking specific distracting sites like YouTube or TikTok. How does whitelist mode work? In whitelist mode, only the websites you explicitly allow can be accessed. Everything else is blocked. Perfect for young children who should only visit approved sites. Can my child disable the extension? You can set a password to protect the settings panel. Without the password, children cannot change the blocking configuration. Does it work on Edge? Yes! kidBlocker works on both Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge since they are both Chromium-based browsers. Is it free? Yes, kidBlocker is completely free and open source. Do settings sync across devices? Yes. If you are signed in to your Chrome or Edge account, all your settings — including your domain lists, mode choice, and password — sync automatically. What are the default blocked sites? The blacklist comes pre-loaded with popular video and social media sites: YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok, Vimeo, Niconico, and more. You can add or remove any domain. What are the default allowed sites? The whitelist comes pre-loaded with kid-friendly sites: PBS Kids, Kidoodle.TV, BBC iPlayer Kids, Nick Jr., and Netflix Kids. How do I unblock a website? Open the kidBlocker popup, find the website in the list, and click the delete icon. Or switch modes entirely. Open Source on GitHub © 2025 kidBlocker. All rights reserved.

终身 无限制使用所有功能 无每日下载次数上限 优先支持与更快的功能更新 Choose Plan FAQ 常见问题 自动分类怎么工作？文件名怎么生成？隐私与权限需要哪些？AI 命名是否可选？这里都有快速解答。 Download Pilot 是什么？ Download Pilot 是一款 Chrome 扩展，帮你把下载自动按类型整理到文件夹，并用网页上下文或可选 AI 把无意义的文件名变成可读名称，让下载夹干净、好找。 它是怎么自动分类下载的？ 下载完成后，Download Pilot 会根据文件类型/扩展名把文件放到对应文件夹（如 Images / Videos / Documents / Audio / Archives / Others）。你也可以自定义扩展名→目录的映射规则。 智能命名会用到哪些网页信息？ 通常会使用页面标题、meta 描述、og:title、图片 alt、链接文字、域名等上下文信息，把类似 `a1b2c3.jpg` 这类文件名改成更清晰的可读名称。 会强制重命名所有下载吗？可以关闭吗？ 不会强制。你可以选择只分类不改名、只对特定类型改名，或针对特定站点/规则启用命名。遇到命名不理想时，也可以回退到原始文件名。 AI 命名是必须的吗？需要配置什么？ AI 命名是可选能力：仅在你需要更语义化的文件名（如论文/报告/素材）时开启。部分 AI 功能可能需要你自行配置服务（例如 API Key）或选择内置方案。 权限与隐私安全吗？会上传我的文件吗？ Download Pilot 的命名主要依赖网页元信息（标题/描述/alt 等）与下载信息来生成建议。启用 AI 命名时，仅会按配置发送有限上下文用于命名；不启用时不会使用 AI。 如何自定义文件夹规则和命名模板？ 你可以按扩展名/类型设置目标文件夹，并使用命名模板（如 `站点-标题-日期`）来统一格式。建议从默认规则开始，逐步加自己的规则避免过度复杂。 支持哪些浏览器/文件类型？ 主要面向 Chrome/Chromium 内核浏览器。常见的图片、视频、PDF、文档、压缩包等类型都适用；如果某类文件命名不准确，可调整规则或改为仅分类。 为什么有些文件命名不够准确？怎么优化？ 智能命名依赖站点提供的上下文信息：有些页面标题不规范、alt 缺失或下载链接缺少语义，会影响效果。你可以：1) 针对站点设定命名规则，2) 使用更合适的模板，3) 仅对特定类型启用 AI 命名。 Download Pilot

title: 粵語拼音轉換工具 - 語音播放器
description: 專業粵語拼音轉換工具：即時將中文轉成標準粵拼 (Jyutping)，內建粵語語音播放器，可逐字播放。支援繁簡體、多音字與兩種輸出格式，適合學習、教學、歌詞標註。
extractedText: 粵語拼音轉換工具 - 語音播放器 粵語拼音網 粵拼轉換 粵拼查詢 音節 IPA 轉換 粵拼教學 博客 繁體中文 简体中文 English 日本語 Open menu 粵拼轉換 粵拼查詢 音節 IPA 轉換 粵拼教學 網站插件 博客 粵語拼音轉換工具 即時將中文字轉換為 粵語拼音 輸入文字 播放 支援繁體及簡體中文 輸出格式 原文 + 拼音 (例：你[nei5]) 僅拼音 (例：nei5 hou2) 轉換結果 複製結果 結果將顯示於此... 轉換器用途 在左欄貼上中文，右邊即時標出粵拼（Jyutping），並可逐字播放。識字但拿不準粵語讀音、要為歌詞或課文加拼音、或查某個字該打哪組輸入碼，都可以用。轉換在瀏覽器完成，文字不會送到伺服器。 常見用法 學習：把課文或對話轉成拼音，對照漢字同讀音。 歌詞：為粵語歌標音，跟着唱。 教材：教師一次為整段課文加上拼音。 輸入法：查不肯定的字該打哪組粵拼。 用法 在左欄貼上或輸入中文（繁簡體均可）。 選「原文 + 拼音」（字後加 [jyutping]）或「僅拼音」。 右邊會即時更新；可播放讀音。 要帶走結果時，按複製。 關於粵拼 粵拼由香港語言學學會（LSHK）於 1993 年為粵語制定，用拉丁字母加數字 1–6 標聲母、韻母、聲調。香港教育、語言學同輸入法多數用這套。 傳統稱「九聲六調」：九個聲調類別，實際音高只有六種；入聲（舊稱 7、8、9 聲）的調值分別同 1、3、6 聲。粵拼只寫 1–6。 耶魯拼音要用 á、ǎ 一類變音符號；國際音標（IPA）用 ŋ、œ 等專用符號。粵拼只用普通鍵盤字元，所以輸入法容易採用。 讀音來源 讀音來自 CanCLID 公開的 to-jyutping 函式庫（BSD-2-Clause），在你的瀏覽器運算。本站不是香港語言學學會（LSHK）官方網站，亦不是教育局或任何院校的課程。粵拼方案由 LSHK 於 1993 年公布；本頁只把該方案同詞庫接到畫面上。多音字排序跟該庫對語境常見程度的估計，第一個較常對，但不保證。 按播放時，瀏覽器會向本站伺服器取該音節的 mp3。你貼上用來轉換的整段中文不會一併上傳。不用註冊、沒有帳戶。若讀音同你在香港聽到的不同，多數是懶音、文白異讀或詞義不同；請用字典看全部候選，不要當本頁是唯一正解。 音訊是每個粵拼音節一段錄音，不是把你整句合成香港人聲。連讀時的聲調同孤立音檔不會完全一樣，這是預期。轉換器的工作是標音節，方便核對歌詞、課文或輸入碼。 怎樣核對轉換結果 貼你真正要用的一句：副歌、點心紙、課堂句子。要字旁有拼音就選「原文＋粵拼」，只操羅馬字就選「僅拼音」。按播放跟着高亮。遇到「行」「好」這種多音字，去字典看，不要信第一個標籤。簡體可以貼；「发」跟詞庫「發」一側，不會自動變成「髮」。 學打字就把常打錯的詞複製去粵語拼音鍵盤（手機多數不用打聲調數字）。你口語說 lei5（你），轉換器仍可能寫 nei5，這是標準同口語之別，不是網站壞了。跟你老師、合唱團或輸入法要的那套。 使用限制 本頁不教連讀、不改你的口音、亦不取代老師或 LSHK 文件。歌詞、教材、輸入法查碼可以用。法庭、廣播審音、學業呈分，請核對你要跟的標準。發現明顯標錯，請電郵說明字、詞、你預期的粵拼。 這裏不是 LSHK 證書、不是教育局分數、亦不保證第一個讀音能當呈堂或試卷標準答案。維護者收到明確錯項會改；不會假裝今天人手審過整張表。 粵語拼音網由個人獨立維護，不是公司或語言學學會。來源、隱私同聯絡： 關於 · 聯絡我們 常見問題 多音字會標錯嗎？ 會選常用讀音。語境特殊（例如「行」讀 hang4 還是 hong4）請到字典看全部候選。 簡體中文可以用嗎？ 可以。一個簡化字對幾個繁體字時（如「发」對「發／髮」），會按常見對應來轉。 同漢語拼音有何分別？ 是另一套方案。粵語保留 ng- 聲母（我 ngo5），有 aa、oe 等韻母，聲調用 1–6，不是普通話四聲。 聲調怎樣記？ 可用「詩史試時市事」（si1–si6）。轉完按播放對照聽。 結果同我習慣的讀法不同？ 這裏標的是較常見的讀法，口語懶音（n/l、ng 脫落）未必列出。以你要學的標準為準。 粵語拼音網 專業的粵語拼音學習平台：中文轉粵拼、內建粵語語音播放器、字典點讀、音節表與可嵌入播放器。 粵拼轉換 隱私權政策 粵拼查詢 音節 使用條款 IPA 轉換 網站插件 博客 關於 聯絡我們 粵拼教學 © 2026 粵語拼音網

Text-to-video, image-to-video, native audio, and reference-driven control for creators who care about final quality. Try Seedance Video Start with a simple workflow. Generate your first clip in minutes. How Seedance 2.0 Works Seedance 2.0 is ByteDance's latest video generation model, built on a unified multimodal architecture for text, image, video, and audio references. In this generator, you can create 480p or 720p video from text or a starting image, with native audio and durations up to 15 seconds. Text to Video Write a scene in plain language — set the mood, describe the camera angle, specify how many characters appear and what they're doing. The model processes complex multi-part prompts (up to 2,500 characters) with multiple subjects, emotional tone, and environmental detail, then renders a video that matches your intent. Image to Video Upload a photo or illustration and the model determines how the scene should move — hair blowing, water rippling, a character turning their head. It preserves fine details like skin texture, jewelry, and fabric patterns while adding natural motion. Built-in Audio Generation Seedance 2.0 generates audio and video together instead of adding sound as a separate post-processing step. Characters can speak with synchronized lip movement, sound effects land with the action, and background ambience matches the setting. Physics-Aware Motion ByteDance incorporated physics-aware training that penalizes impossible motion during generation. Cloth drapes and wrinkles naturally, water splashes with the right weight, collisions have impact, and characters shift their balance when they walk. From a subtle eyebrow raise to a full martial arts fight scene with debris, motion stays physically grounded. Gallery See What Seedance Can Do Every clip below was generated by Seedance models — no post-editing, no compositing. Click any thumbnail to play. Try SAM 3D Now Try SAM 3 Now ✓ Supports objects & human bodies | ✓ Fast inference | ✓ Export in standard 3D formats Two Breakthrough Models for Comprehensive 3D Understanding SAM 3D introduces two specialized architectures designed to handle the complexities of the physical world. Moving beyond synthetic datasets, these models leverage a massive new data engine to understand occlusion, diverse lighting, and complex geometries. SAM 3D Objects: Scene-Aware Reconstruction Reconstruct detailed 3D shapes, textures, and layouts from a single image. Unlike previous methods limited to isolated objects, SAM 3D Objects thrives in cluttered, real-world environments. It allows users to select any object in a photo and instantly generate a pose-aware 3D mesh, enabling applications like 'View in Room' for e-commerce and interactive 3D scene editing. SAM 3D Body: Precise Human Digitization Generate accurate 3D human pose and shape estimations even in challenging conditions involving unusual postures or partial occlusions. Built on the new Meta Momentum Human Rig (MHR), it separates skeletal structure from soft tissue shape, offering interpretable and animatable 3D human models for VR, gaming, and sports analysis. The Data Engine Advantage Our revolutionary 'Human-in-the-Loop' data engine annotated nearly 1 million physical world images, generating over 3 million verified meshes. This approach bridges the 'sim-to-real' gap, allowing SAM 3D to generalize across diverse real-world scenarios where purely synthetic-trained models fail. Why SAM 3D Redefines the Standard We've moved beyond the limitations of traditional photogrammetry and synthetic-only training. SAM 3D brings semantic understanding to 3D reconstruction. Unmatched Robustness in the Wild Traditional 3D models struggle with the chaos of the real world. SAM 3D excels. Whether it's low light, heavy occlusion, or non-standard camera angles, our models maintain high fidelity. In head-to-head human preference tests, SAM 3D Objects achieves a 5:1 win rate over current state-of-the-art alternatives. Promptable & Interactive Interface Real-Time Performance Workflow From 2D Image to 3D Asset in 4 Steps Experience the power of SAM 3D through our intuitive Playground or integrate it directly into your Python workflow. 1 Upload Your Image Start with any standard RGB image. It could be a photo from your phone, a frame from a video, or a generated image. 2 Prompt the Model Click on the object or person you want to reconstruct. SAM 3D instantly generates a segmentation mask to confirm your selection. 3 Generate 3D Mesh The model infers the 3D geometry, texture, and pose, producing a high-quality mesh in seconds using our efficient inference pipeline. 4 Export & Integrate Download your asset in standard formats like .OBJ, .GLB, or the new MHR format for human bodies, ready for use in Blender, Unity, or Unreal Engine. Meta Momentum Human Rig (MHR) A new open-source mesh format separating skeletal structure from soft tissue for superior animation. Occlusion Handling Advanced inference logic hallucinates plausible back-facing geometry for occluded objects. SA-3DAO Dataset Trained on the new SAM 3D Artist Objects dataset, featuring 1M+ visually grounded real-world images. extractedText: UV Index Today: Live UV Index Tracker & Sun Safety Guide UV Index Today Real-time solar radiation monitoring Service Unavailable We're having trouble connecting to our data source. Please try again in a few moments. Retry How to read today's UV index The UV index measures the strength of ultraviolet radiation at the ground, not how hot the air feels. Heat comes from infrared; UV can be high on a cool, bright day and still damage skin and eyes. Use the live number above as a planning signal before outdoor time. Check the current value and today's peak. If the peak sits in the High or Very High range, schedule longer outdoor activity earlier or later, pack sunscreen, and prefer shade when the sun is overhead. Plan your day with the next few hours A short forecast window helps more than a single snapshot. Cloud cover can drop UV for an hour, then clear and push levels back up. If you are commuting, exercising, or taking children outside, glance at the next three hours and match protection to the highest expected stretch. Skin type, medication, and altitude change how aggressively you should protect yourself. Fairer skin burns faster; higher elevations receive stronger UV. When conditions look elevated, default to clothing and sunscreen rather than waiting for a sunburn warning from your skin. From the blog All posts How to Use a Live UV Index Before You Go Outside The three numbers on this site—current, today’s peak, and the next few hours—and how to match them to shade, clothing, and sunscreen. Hours at UV 4 Can Outdose Minutes at UV 8 The UV index is a rate, not a daily budget. Plan the length of the outing, not only the peak. Skin Type Changes Burn Minutes, Not the Index The live UV index is a sky rate everyone under it shares. Phototype changes how fast that rate can redden unprotected skin. The Bottle SPF Assumes a Coat You Rarely Put On Lab SPF is scored at 2 mg/cm². Typical use is thinner, so the bottle number is not the skin number. Sun Protection Essentials Hat & Shade A wide-brimmed hat and shade break reduce exposure to the face, ears, and neck. UV Sunglasses Wrap-around styles that block UV help protect eyes during bright midday conditions. SPF 30+ Apply enough sunscreen and reapply about every two hours, including on cloudy days. Avoid Midday UV is usually strongest around late morning through mid-afternoon—plan outdoor tasks outside that window when you can. UV Index Scale & Meaning 0-2 Low Minimal protection needed for most people. Still watch reflective surfaces outdoors. 3-5 Moderate Seek shade near midday. Wear a shirt, hat, and SPF 30+ sunscreen. 6-7 High Limit time in the sun from late morning to mid-afternoon. Cover up and reapply sunscreen. 8-10 Very High Unprotected skin can burn quickly. Extra precautions are required outdoors. 11+ Extreme Avoid peak sun when possible. Use shade, clothing, and broad-spectrum sunscreen. Why surroundings raise your UV dose Surfaces bounce UV back toward you. Standing near reflective ground can mean a higher effective dose than the plain index suggests—especially at the beach or in snow. Water Can reflect a meaningful share of UV. Swimmers and boaters still need protection. Dry Sand Beach sand reflects UV upward, intensifying exposure for people sitting or walking nearby. Fresh Snow Snow can reflect a large fraction of UV—alpine days often need sunglasses and SPF even when cold. Limits of these readings Values on this page are estimates for everyday sun-safety planning. Local clouds, shade, altitude, and time of day can move real exposure up or down. Readings are not medical advice and do not replace professional care if you have a skin condition or unusual reaction to the sun. When unsure, protect more rather than less: shade, clothing, broad-spectrum sunscreen, and shorter midday sessions. description: 词刻 WordMoment 是一个纯前端、无广告的背单词网站，通过键盘输入与累积式重复强化，帮助你高效记住英语单词，适合 CET4 / CET6 等英语词汇记忆。

extractedText: 词刻 WordMoment｜通过输入与重复强化高效背单词 一个通过输入来背单词的英语记忆工具 词刻（WordMoment）是一个专注于 背单词 和 英语词汇记忆 的在线工具， 通过键盘输入和重复强化的方式，帮助学习者真正记住英语单词。 与传统的单词卡片或机械重复不同，词刻强调 主动回忆 ， 每一个新单词都需要用户亲自输入，从而加深记忆痕迹。 在学习过程中，每当你完成一个新单词的输入，系统都会从第一个单词开始， 依次播放已学单词的强化展示，让单词在短时间内反复出现， 适合 CET4 背单词 、 CET6 背单词 以及日常英语词汇积累。 词刻不提供广告、不做社交、不追求刷题速度， 只专注于帮助你用更少的单词量，获得更牢固的记忆效果。 如果你正在寻找一个 高效、干净、长期可用的背单词网站 ， 词刻将是一个值得尝试的选择。 入力で英単語を暗記する英語記憶ツール 詞刻（WordMoment）は、 英単語暗記 と 英語語彙記憶 に特化したオンラインツールです。 キーボード入力と反復強化を通じて、学習者が英単語を本当に記憶できるよう支援します。 従来の単語カードや機械的な反復とは異なり、詞刻は 能動的想起 を重視し、 すべての新しい単語をユーザー自身が入力することで、記憶の痕跡を深めます。 学習プロセスでは、新しい単語の入力を完了するたびに、システムは最初の単語から順に 学習済み単語の強化表示を再生し、短時間で単語を繰り返し表示します。 CET4 単語暗記 、 CET6 単語暗記 、および日常的な英語語彙の蓄積に適しています。 詞刻は広告を提供せず、ソーシャル機能もなく、問題を解く速度を追求しません。 より少ない単語数で、より強固な記憶効果を得られることに専念しています。 効率的で、クリーンで、長期的に使用できる単語暗記サイト をお探しなら、 詞刻は試す価値のある選択肢です。

Compare the original color image with its grayscale result to check tonal separation, contrast, and subject detail before downloading. What Is a Grayscale Image ? A grayscale image is a digital image in which each pixel carries only a single intensity value representing how bright it is. Unlike color images — where every pixel stores separate red, green, and blue (RGB) channels — a grayscale pixel uses just one channel with 256 possible shades, ranging from 0 (pure black) to 255 (pure white). This 8-bit depth produces the smooth, continuous tonal gradations you see in classic black-and-white photography. You may also see it written as "gray scale image" (two words) or "greyscale image" in British English — they all mean the same thing. Today, grayscale conversion is used in photography, print prep, OCR workflows, computer vision, and everyday web image editing. The key idea is simple: remove color, keep tone. That makes grayscale useful when shape, contrast, texture, and brightness matter more than hue. After converting a portrait or profile photo, you can use a circle crop tool to give the finished image a clean, round frame. Grayscale vs Black and White People often use "grayscale" and "black and white" interchangeably, but they refer to different things technically. A true black-and-white image contains only two values — pure black and pure white — with no shades of gray in between. A grayscale image, on the other hand, preserves a full range of 256 tones. In everyday photography language, "black and white" usually means grayscale. If you need a strict 1-bit output for OCR or line art, our monochrome converter applies a brightness threshold to produce pure binary results. Reset How to Use the Mouse Sensitivity Converter Use the same four inputs shown in the converter to create a physical-distance match between two games. 01 Choose your source game Search the supported catalog and select the game whose current sensitivity you already use. 02 Enter sensitivity and DPI Enter the in-game sensitivity and mouse DPI from your source setup. Both values must be greater than zero. 03 Choose your target game Select the game you want to move to and enter its DPI if it differs from the source setup. 04 Copy your converted sensitivity Read or copy the target sensitivity, then use cm/360 or in/360 to verify the shared physical distance. How Mouse Sensitivity Conversion Works The converter normalizes your source setting into the physical mouse distance needed for a 360° turn, then solves the target game's sensitivity for that same distance. 1. Measure the source 360° distance Source game, in-game sensitivity, and mouse DPI determine how many inches or centimeters the mouse travels for one complete turn. 2. Solve the target sensitivity The target game's model and target DPI turn that shared physical distance back into a target in-game sensitivity. Worked example: Valorant to CS2 Valorant 0.4 at 800 DPI converts to CS2 1.27273 at 800 DPI. Both settings equal about 40.821 cm/360. Game-specific models, not one universal ratio A simple coefficient ratio works only for linear sensitivity scales. Games with affine, cubic, or exponential behavior use their existing game-specific inverse formula to preserve the same physical 360-distance. What this conversion does not model This converter covers base or hipfire sensitivity. It does not separately model ADS or scoped multipliers, FOV, mouse acceleration, input latency, camera animation, or other visual differences, so equal cm/360 does not guarantee identical perceived motion. eDPI vs cm/360 vs in/360 These outputs answer different questions. Use the game-specific value for setup and the physical-distance values for reliable cross-game comparison. Converted Sensitivity The in-game number to enter in the selected target game at your chosen target DPI. eDPI In-game sensitivity multiplied by mouse DPI. It is useful within the same game or a shared sensitivity scale, not as a universal cross-game measurement. cm/360 The centimeters your mouse travels for a complete 360° turn. Use it to compare physical sensitivity across games and setups. in/360 The same physical 360° distance as cm/360, expressed in inches instead of centimeters. cm/360 and in/360 describe the same physical distance in different units. Matching eDPI alone does not guarantee a matching turn distance across different games. extractedText: DR Checker - Free Website Domain Rating Checker DR Checker .org Leaderboard Discover Compare Switch language Sign In DR Checker .org Switch language ✨ All DR Data is Updated Daily Instant & Free DR Checker Quickly and accurately check any website's domain rating Check Enter a URL to check and track the DR value Ahrefs data Refreshed every 24 hours History and comparison Recently checked domains View all NEW 0 detoxdatabase.net NEW 0 personaltrainerwebsite.com NEW 1 reelmotion.fit NEW 15 vofy.art + 6 13 aurascan.app + 1 4 pdfpix.com Domain authority made practical A DR Checker Built for Clearer SEO Decisions Check any website's current Domain Rating in seconds. DR Checker keeps competitor research, link prospecting, and routine SEO reviews simple. How the DR Checker Works Three quick steps turn a website address into a useful Domain Rating result. 1 Enter the Domain Paste a root domain or full URL. Unnecessary URL details are removed before the lookup starts. 2 Retrieve the Current DR A recent saved result is used when available, while stale Domain Rating data is refreshed through Ahrefs. 3 Interpret and Compare Review the score, open its history, or compare domains. Use DR Checker as a starting point, not a final verdict. What You Can Do With DR Checker Review, track, compare, and explore domain authority from one focused workspace. Check Domain Rating Fast Enter a website to normalize its URL, retrieve its Ahrefs Domain Rating, and see a clear result. Track Meaningful Changes Return later to see whether a domain's relative backlink strength is rising, stable, or falling over time. Compare Competing Domains Place domains side by side to spot authority gaps between your site, competitors, partners, and prospects. Explore the Wider Market Explore leaderboards and recently checked sites to place one result in a wider market context. Understand the metric How to Read a DR Checker Result Learn what the score measures, how to benchmark it, and when the result needs more context. Domain Rating scale 0-100 Compare websites in the same market instead of chasing a universal target. Higher scores become progressively harder to earn. 0 20 40 60 80 100 What Does Domain Rating Measure? Domain Rating is an Ahrefs metric that estimates the relative strength of a website's backlink profile. The value runs from 0 to 100 on a logarithmic scale, which means progress generally becomes harder at higher levels. DR Checker reports that domain-level value; it does not calculate a separate proprietary authority score or quietly blend unrelated metrics into the number. What Is a Good DR Score? There is no universal score that becomes good for every website. A local service business, a new software product, an established publication, and a global marketplace operate in very different link environments. Use DR Checker to establish a relevant benchmark: check direct competitors, sites ranking for the same topics, and realistic partnership candidates. A result of 30 may be competitive in one niche and ordinary in another. When Should You Use DR Checker? DR Checker is useful during competitor research, outreach qualification, backlink audits, partnership reviews, expired-domain research, directory assessment, and recurring client reporting. For outreach, a result can help you prioritize a long list, but topical relevance and editorial quality should still decide whether a placement is worthwhile. For competitor work, the score can reveal an authority gap that deserves deeper backlink analysis. What DR Checker Cannot Tell You DR Checker cannot prove that a website is trustworthy, relevant, or likely to rank for a keyword. Domain Rating is not a Google metric or direct ranking factor. A strong DR Checker result can still be a poor fit, so review actual backlinks, traffic, content quality, and topical alignment before making an important decision. Domain Rating (DR) is Ahrefs' relative 0–100 metric for the strength of a website's backlink profile. It considers the strength of linking domains and how they distribute links. DR is not a Google ranking factor. This Domain Rating checker returns the currently available provider observation rather than Ahrefs' complete backlink product. Relative Compare Like with Like A lower observation is meaningful only against relevant peers and the same provider. Inspect the underlying links before deciding what action is needed. DR Use DR for a Domain Mid-range observations have no universal good or bad meaning. Niche, competitor set, provider coverage, and observation date all matter. Context Inspect the Context A higher observation means a stronger backlink profile in Ahrefs' relative model. Compare relevant domains instead of treating one band as universally strong. DR vs DA — What's the Difference? Domain Rating (DR) is Ahrefs' metric that measures backlink strength on a 0–100 scale. Domain Authority (DA) is Moz's metric for ranking potential on a 1–100 scale. Both are useful, but they use different algorithms and data sources. Our free DR checker uses Ahrefs data, while our DA checker uses Moz data. Check DA → How is Domain Rating Calculated? Referring Domains DR evaluates linking domains within Ahrefs' graph and accounts for how each source distributes links across other domains. A source's headline DR alone does not determine what one link contributes. Logarithmic Scale DR uses a logarithmic scale from 0 to 100. Moving from DR 20 to 30 is exponentially easier than moving from 70 to 80. Each point increase represents a significant jump in link authority. Code）是一种由日本Denso公司发明的二维条形码技术，可以在水平和垂直两个方向存储数据。相比传统的一维条码，二维码具有更高的数据容量和更快的扫描速度。二维码可以用来存储网址、文本、电话号码、联系人信息、支付链接等。用户只需使用手机摄像头或扫码应用对准二维码，即可识别并访问其中的内容。在日常生活中，二维码广泛应用于移动支付、票务系统、电子名片、智能设备配网、广告跳转等多个场景，成为信息传递的重要工具。对于企业和个人而言，二维码是连接线下与线上内容的快捷桥梁。 二维码和条形码的区别是什么？ 点击展开查看详细解答 二维码和条形码的主要区别在于数据存储方式、容量、容错能力和使用场景。条形码是一维的，只能在横向存储信息，通常容量较小（几十个字符以内），主要用于超市、仓储等商品管理领域。而二维码是二维的，既能横向也能纵向存储信息，容量远高于条形码，最多可存储上千个字符，并且具有更强的容错能力，即使部分二维码损坏仍能识别。二维码还支持多种类型的数据（如网址、图片链接、支付指令等），适用于支付、营销、身份识别等场景。此外，二维码更容易与手机端交互，而条形码多依赖激光扫描枪识别。 为什么二维码如此流行？ 点击展开查看详细解答 二维码之所以广泛流行，主要得益于其多功能性、易用性和低成本。首先，二维码可以在极小的空间内存储大量信息，适用于各种设备和应用场景；其次，用户只需使用智能手机即可扫描识别，无需额外硬件，大大降低了使用门槛。同时，二维码生成简单、成本低廉，企业和个人都可以轻松制作。随着移动互联网的发展，二维码成为连接线上线下的重要工具，广泛应用于移动支付、广告营销、门票验真、设备绑定、社交分享等领域。此外，二维码还具有良好的容错能力，即便部分破损或遮挡仍可正常识别，使其在实际使用中更为稳定和可靠。 常见问题 CodeBox如何追踪二维码的扫码数据和效果？ 什么是动态二维码？ 点击收起答案 动态二维码是一种可以在二维码生成后仍可修改其指向内容的二维码类型。与静态二维码不同，静态二维码生成时内容固定，无法更改；而动态二维码通常指向一个短链接或中间跳转页，真正的跳转地址由服务器控制。这种方式使得用户即使扫描同一个二维码，也可以根据时间、设备、用户属性跳转到不同内容，支持 A/B 测试、推广渠道识别等功能。此外，动态二维码可记录访问行为，如扫描次数、来源设备、时间、地理位置等，广泛用于营销活动、会员管理和内容追踪等场景。 什么是短链接追踪？ 点击展开查看详细解答 短链接追踪是一种通过缩短后的链接（如 https://t.cn/xxxxx 或自定义域名）来追踪用户点击行为的技术手段。每一个短链接在用户点击时，都会通过服务器中转，这一过程会记录用户的信息，如IP地址、操作系统、浏览器类型、访问时间等，进而生成详细的数据报告。在动态二维码系统中，二维码通常指向的就是一个短链接，从而实现扫描行为的数据统计与追踪。通过短链接追踪，企业可以了解用户来源、识别高效渠道、衡量广告转化，甚至区分不同市场投放效果，是数据驱动运营的重要手段。 如何进行扫描数据的采集？ 点击展开查看详细解答 扫描数据的采集通常依赖动态二维码所连接的服务器进行。当用户扫码访问二维码中的短链接或跳转页时，系统会自动采集该次请求的元信息。这些信息包括但不限于：访问时间、地理位置（根据 IP 推断）、设备类型、操作系统、浏览器型号、访问来源页面、用户唯一标识（如通过参数传递）等。所有这些数据可以储存在数据库中，用于后续分析。数据采集的关键在于不影响用户体验的同时，确保采集准确和高效。同时，在实际应用中，需确保遵守相关的隐私政策与数据保护法规，如 GDPR 或中国的《个人信息保护法》。 什么是二维码数据的可视化展示？ 点击展开查看详细解答 二维码数据的可视化展示是指通过图表、图形、数据面板等方式，将二维码扫描所产生的数据以直观、易理解的形式呈现给用户或管理者。常见的展示方式包括折线图展示每日扫描趋势、饼图显示设备类型占比、地图标注扫码地理分布、柱状图对比不同二维码或渠道的表现等。这种可视化方式可以帮助企业或运营人员快速识别用户行为模式、市场投放效果或活动热度，从而优化策略与内容。优秀的可视化平台通常支持自定义时间区间筛选、导出数据报表、设置数据预警，增强运营决策的效率与准确性。 常见问题 二维码的畅想 二维码的前景及未来如何？ 点击收起答案 二维码作为一种轻量级的信息入口，已经深度融入支付、营销、物流、教育等多个领域。未来，随着物联网和人工智能的发展，二维码的角色将从“信息入口”进化为“智能连接器”，承载更多与身份认证、实时数据交互、设备控制相关的功能。例如，结合区块链技术的二维码可以用于防伪溯源、可信数据传递；结合AI视觉的二维码可自动生成个性化内容或广告；在智能制造与智慧城市场景中，二维码可能成为数字化资产管理和人机交互的重要节点。总体来看，二维码因其低成本、高灵活性与技术适应性，在未来的数字化时代仍具有广阔的应用前景。 我国二维码的使用量及场景有多广？ 点击展开查看详细解答 我国是全球二维码应用最广泛、最深入的国家之一。根据工业和信息化部、国家标准委等数据，截至近年，全国日均二维码扫描量已超过百亿次，涉及用户覆盖率极高。从移动支付（微信、支付宝）到共享出行（扫码骑车）、智慧医疗（扫码挂号）、政务服务（电子证照）、快递物流（包裹追踪）再到电商营销（扫码领券、拼团裂变）等场景，二维码已成为中国数字社会的基础工具。尤其在后疫情时代，健康码、行程码更让国民对二维码的接受度

extractedText: ‎Halftime - Time Tracker Widget App - App Store Search Today Games Apps Arcade Platform iPhone iPad Mac Vision Watch TV Halftime - Time Tracker Widget Life Progress & Year Countdown Free · In‑App Purchases Share 4 Ratings 5.0 Age Rating 4+ Years Category Lifestyle Developer 虎 伏 Language EN + 7 More Size 16.8 MB iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch How much time do you actually have left? Halftime helps you see time clearly, from the next hour to the shape of your entire life. Instead of hiding time inside lists, charts, or abstract numbers, Halftime turns your day, week, month, year, and life into a quiet matrix of dots. Each dot is a moment. Some have passed. Some are still ahead. Some can still be filled with focus, meaning, and intention. Halftime is not a traditional to-do list, habit tracker, or productivity system. It is a visual time tracker designed to help you understand where you are, what matters, and how you want to spend the time you still have. Key Features • Visual Time Matrix See your Day, Week, Month, Year, and Life as clean dot-based timelines. Zoom from the micro view of today to the macro view of your life. • Life Progress Set your birthday and expected lifespan to visualize your life progress in weeks and years. A simple, powerful reminder to make the present count. • Focus Timer Start a focused session with a simple gesture. Turn passing time into visible progress and transform grey dots into colorful records of attention. • Special Days Track birthdays, anniversaries, trips, deadlines, goals, and meaningful moments with countdowns and progress views. • Home Screen and Lock Screen Widgets Keep your Life, Day, Week, Month, Year, and Special Days progress visible without opening the app. • Apple Watch Support Check your time progress from your wrist. Add Halftime complications to your watch face for Life, Year, Month, Week, Day, and selected Special Days. • Visual Heatmap Your effort is more than a number. Watch your timeline light up as you focus, build routines, and create a visual record of how your time is spent. • Shareable Timeline Cards Create clean visual cards for your time progress and share your Day, Month, Year, or Life timeline. Why Halftime? Halftime is for people who want to: • Feel the passage of time more clearly • Track life progress without anxiety or clutter • Build focus with a minimal timer • Visualize habits, effort, and attention • Remember important dates and countdowns • Use widgets and Apple Watch complications as gentle reminders • Spend less time scrolling and more time living Design Philosophy Halftime is intentionally simple. No ads. No noisy social features. No complicated project systems. No endless settings. Just a calm, visual way to understand time and make better choices with it. Time does not become longer when you track it. But when you can see it, you can choose it more deliberately. Stop scrolling. Start living. Welcome to Halftime. Take control of your second half. 먼저 확인해야 합니다. 이 안내는 합법 여부를 점검하고, 의심스러운 권유나 금전 피해가 발생했을 때 증거를 보존하는 방법을 이용자 관점에서 정리한 공익 정보입니다. 특정 사업자의 가입이나 이용을 권하지 않으며, 최신 내용은 관계 기관과 해당 운영 주체의 공지에서 다시 확인해야 합니다. 토토사이트 관련 정보를 찾을 때는 검색 문구보다 운영 주체와 국내 법적 근거를 먼저 확인하는 것이 중요합니다. 합법적인 이용인지 먼저 구분하기 국내에서 스포츠 관련 투표권 서비스를 이용할 때는 법령에 근거한 발행 주체와 허용된 판매·구매 경로가 있는지 확인해야 합니다. 인터넷 광고에 등장하는 명칭, 유명 선수 이미지, 높은 적중금이나 환급을 내세운 문구만으로 합법성을 판단할 수는 없습니다. 운영 주체와 수탁 관계가 공개되어 있는지 확인합니다. 관련 법령, 이용약관, 환급 및 적중금 지급 기준을 직접 읽어봅니다. 공식 홈페이지 주소와 안내된 판매 경로가 일치하는지 주소를 직접 입력해 점검합니다. 개인 계좌 입금, 비공식 메신저 결제, 대리 구매를 요구하면 이용을 중단합니다. 출처 자료에는 체육진흥투표권의 공식 온라인 발매 경로로 베트맨이 안내되어 있습니다. 다만 주소나 운영 정보는 변경될 수 있으므로 접속 전 관계 기관과 운영 주체의 최신 공지를 함께 확인하는 것이 좋습니다. 스포츠토토사이트라는 표현도 명칭만으로 합법성을 의미하지 않으므로 실제 운영 근거와 제도적 지위를 구분해 확인해야 합니다. 이어 읽기 합법적인 체육진흥투표권과 불법 사설 스포츠도박 사이트를 구분하는 기준 자세히 보기 구매 제한과 건전 이용 원칙 참고자료는 체육진흥투표권에 회차당 1인 구매 한도가 적용되며, 미성년자와 발행 대상 경기의 관계자는 구매하거나 환급금을 받을 수 없다고 안내합니다. 구체적인 한도와 자격은 상품과 시점에 따라 달라질 수 있으므로 이용 전 최신 약관과 공지를 확인해야 합니다. 생활비, 대출금, 타인의 돈을 사용하지 않습니다. 잃은 금액을 만회하려고 구매액을 늘리지 않습니다. 구매 내역과 지출 금액을 기록하고 정한 한도를 넘기지 않습니다. 반복적으로 통제하기 어렵거나 일상생활에 지장이 생기면 즉시 이용을 중단하고 상담을 검토합니다. 투표권은 수익을 보장하는 금융상품이 아닙니다. 적중 가능성이나 환급 여부를 단정하는 광고는 이용자의 합리적인 판단을 흐릴 수 있습니다. 온라인 광고에서 메이저사이트라는 표현이 사용되더라도 그 문구 자체가 안전성이나 합법성을 보장하지는 않습니다. 위험한 광고와 권유를 식별하는 방법 다음과 같은 표현은 합법적인 운영 근거를 보여주는 자료가 아니라 위험 신호일 수 있습니다. 광고 화면, 대화 내용, 입금 안내를 삭제하지 말고 원본 상태로 보관하세요. 가입 즉시 보너스나 손실 보전을 제공한다는 약속 적중을 보장하거나 내부 정보가 있다고 주장하는 말 출금을 위해 추가 세금, 보증금, 해제 비용을 먼저 내라는 요구 명의가 다른 계좌로 송금하거나 상품권·가상자산으로 결제하라는 안내 신분증, 통장 사본, 인증번호를 메신저로 보내라는 요구 신고나 환불을 언급하면 대화방을 폐쇄하거나 압박하는 행동 의심스러운 권유를 받았다면 링크를 다시 누르지 말고, 비밀번호를 변경하며, 금융기관에 거래 중지나 지급정지 가능 여부를 문의하세요. 안전놀이터 같은 홍보성 명칭 역시 객관적인 인증이나 법적 지위를 뜻하는 표현으로 받아들여서는 안 됩니다. 피해가 의심될 때 증거를 정리하는 순서 피해 대응에서는 빠른 삭제보다 원본 보존이 중요합니다. 다음 내용을 시간순으로 정리하면 상담이나 신고 시 사실관계를 설명하기 쉬워집니다. 사이트 주소, 광고 게시물 주소, 운영자 계정과 연락처를 기록합니다. 가입·입금·출금·환불 요청 화면을 날짜와 시간이 보이도록 저장합니다. 대화 내용은 앞뒤 맥락이 보이게 보관하고, 상대방의 계좌번호와 입금자명을 따로 적습니다. 은행 이체확인증, 카드 승인 내역, 가상자산 거래 기록 등 결제 자료를 확보합니다. 피해 금액과 발생 날짜를 합산하되, 추정 금액과 실제 이체 금액을 구분합니다. 신고서에는 사실, 요청한 조치, 첨부 자료 목록을 나누어 작성합니다. 증거를 공개 게시판에 올릴 때는 주민등록번호, 주소, 계좌 비밀번호, 인증번호 등 불필요한 개인정보를 가리고, 원본 파일은 별도로 안전하게 보관하세요. 토토커뮤니티의 게시물이나 이용후기는 광고·제휴성 정보가 섞여 있을 수 있어 공식 자료와 별도로 교차 확인할 필요가 있습니다. 신고·상담을 준비할 때 확인할 점 불법 운영이나 금전 피해가 의심되면 거래에 사용한 금융기관, 경찰 등 관계 기관의 공식 신고·상담 창구를 이용하세요. 자료를 제출하기 전 신고 대상의 주소와 운영자 정보, 거래 내역을 한 장의 요약표로 정리하면 상담 시간을 줄일 수 있습니다. 언제, 어디서, 어떤 광고나 권유를 받았는지 적습니다. 얼마를 누구의 계좌로 보냈고 출금이나 환불이 어떻게 거절됐는지 기록합니다. 현재 계정 접근이 가능한지, 개인정보가 유출됐는지 확인합니다. 추가 입금 요구에는 응하지 말고 신고 접수번호와 상담 내용을 보관합니다. 이미 송금했다면 즉시 금융기관에 연락해 가능한 조치를 문의하고, 피해 사실을 관계 기관에 신고하세요. 신고 결과나 환급 여부는 사건과 자료에 따라 달라질 수 있으므로 누구도 결과를 보장할 수 없습니다. 칼럼 보충 Q&A 광고에 공식이라고 적혀 있으면 믿어도 되나요? 그 문구만으로는 충분하지 않습니다. 운영 주체, 법적 근거, 공식 주소, 약관, 결제 방식이 서로 일치하는지 확인하고, 관계 기관이나 운영 주체가 직접 게시한 최신 안내와 대조해야 합니다. 출금을 위해 추가 입금을 요구받았습니다. 어떻게 해야 하나요? 추가 입금을 중단하고 대화 내용과 입금 안내를 저장하세요. 거래 은행에 즉시 연락해 가능한 지급정지나 피해 구제 절차를 문의하고, 계좌번호·사이트 주소·피해 내역을 정리해 관계 기관에 상담 또는 신고하세요. 신고할 때 어떤 자료가 필요한가요? 사이트 주소와 광고 화면, 운영자와 주고받은 대화, 입출금 내역, 계좌번호, 피해 날짜와 금액, 환불 요청 및 답변 자료가 도움이 됩니다. 원본을 보존하고 개인정보와 인증정보는 공개 자료에서 가리세요. 미성년자가 이용한 사실을 알게 되면 어떻게 해야 하나요? 추가 이용과 결제를 즉시 멈추게 하고 보호자와 함께 금융기관 및 관계 기관의 공식 상담 창구에 문의하세요. 거래 내역과 권유 메시지를 삭제하지 말고 보존하며, 신분증이나 인증번호가 노출됐다면 관련 계정의 비밀번호도 변경해야 합니다. 공식 온라인 발매 경로는 어떻게 확인하나요? 검색 광고나 메신저 링크를 바로 누르지 말고 관계 기관 또는 운영 주체의 공식 공지에서 주소를 확인한 뒤 직접 입력하세요. 주소 철자, 보안 연결, 약관, 고객센터 정보가 안내 내용과 일치하는지도 함께 점검해야 합니다. 칼럼 참고자료 제공된 외부 참고자료의 사업 안내, 관련 법령·약관 메뉴, 구매 제한과 공식 온라인 발매 경로 안내를 바탕으로 이용자보호와 피해예방 관점에서 재구성했습니다. 최신 법령과 운영 정보는 관계 기관 및 해당 운영 주체의 공식 공지를 다시 확인하세요. 마지막 검토: 2026년 9월 16일 관련 칼럼 법률·안전 합법적인 체육진흥투표권과 불법 사설 스포츠도박 사이트를 구분하는 기준 이용자보호 사설 스포츠 사이트가 내세우는 신뢰성·안정성·합법성 표현을 A Random Letter Generator is an online tool that randomly generates a specified number of letters based on your settings. The Random Letter Generator supports multiple languages including English, Chinese, and more, with various customization options to meet different needs. Which languages does the Random Letter Generator support? The Random Letter Generator supports 10 languages, including English, Spanish, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Arabic, Greek, and Hebrew. How do I set the number of letters to generate in the Random Letter Generator? In the Random Letter Generator's "Number of Letters" input field, enter the number of letters you want to generate (default is 10). Can the Random Letter Generator choose to generate uppercase or lowercase letters? Yes, in the Random Letter Generator's "Case Options", you can choose uppercase to generate uppercase letters (A-Z), lowercase to generate lowercase letters (a-z), or select both options for the Random Letter Generator to generate mixed case letters. Can the Random Letter Generator include custom characters? Yes! Use the Random Letter Generator's "Custom Characters" field to add any special characters you want to include in the generation. HTTPS 암호화 프로토콜 접속 확인 어떠한 웹사이트든 접속 시 주소창 왼쪽에 자물쇠 아이콘이 활성화되어 있는지, 그리고 프로토콜이 https:// 로 시작하는지 반드시 확인해야 합니다. HTTPS는 브라우저와 서버 간의 데이터를 암호화하여 전송하므로, 중간에서 데이터를 가로채는 스니핑 공격을 원천 차단합니다. 공식 주소핫 사이트는 강력한 SSL/TLS 인증서를 적용하여 사용자의 모든 통신을 완벽하게 보호하고 있습니다. 본문의 분석을 이어서 보면 문의 안내 항목도 같은 맥락에서 검토해야 할 핵심 주제입니다. 2. 신뢰할 수 있는 도메인 확장자 식별 피싱 사이트들은 대개 비용이 저렴하거나 규제가 느슨한 도메인 확장자(.com, .net 등 흔한 확장자를 포함하여 교묘하게 변형된 형태)를 무단 등록하여 사용합니다. 앞서 경고한 바와 같이, 주소핫의 공식 확장자는 오직 .space 뿐입니다. .com 이나 한글 도메인(.com)으로 유도하는 사이트는 100% 사기 사이트 이므로 즉시 접속을 중단해야 합니다. 실제 사례를 살펴볼 때 평가 신뢰도 판단 기준 부분은 위험성, 용어, 판단 기준을 함께 확인하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 3. 가상 사설망(VPN) 및 보안 DNS 활용 공공 와이파이 환경이나 보안이 취약한 네트워크에서 주소모음 사이트에 접근할 때는 신뢰할 수 있는 VPN 서비스를 활성화하는 것이 좋습니다. 또한 Cloudflare(1.1.1.1)나 Google(8.8.8.8)에서 제공하는 보안 DNS(DNS over HTTPS)를 설정하면, 해커가 DNS 정보를 변조하여 엉뚱한 피싱 사이트로 접속을 유도하는 'DNS 스푸핑' 공격을 효과적으로 예방할 수 있습니다. 관련 용어를 정리하는 과정에서는 편집 정책 및 콘텐츠 검수 역시 함께 살펴봐야 문맥이 끊기지 않습니다. 💡 보안 전문가가 권장하는 주소모음 안전 접근 3계명 즐겨찾기(북마크)에 오직 공식 주소인 https://jusohot.space 만 등록하여 사용하기 출처가 불분명한 문자 메시지나 SNS 링크를 통해 주소모음 사이트에 접속하지 않기 브라우저 및 백신 프로그램을 항상 최신 버전으로 업

extractedText: Free Attractiveness Test | AI Face Rating & Pretty Scale Attractiveness Scale Features Am I Attractive? Take the Free AI Attractiveness Test Upload a clear selfie to take a free AI attractiveness test and get an instant, photo-based face rating. The report explains visible photo quality, facial balance, lighting, angle, and practical ways to take a better picture. Use it for curiosity and self-improvement, not as a final judgment of beauty or personal value. No History ✨ Photo Feedback Clear AI Signal Clear Upload Photo Clear, well-lit photo OR TRY A SAMPLE Privacy-friendly analysis AI Powered Instant Results Free to try Instant photo report Private photo analysis Useful photo tips How This AI Face Rating Works The tool uses a simple photo-based flow, so the result is easy to understand and compare. 1 Upload a Clear Selfie Start with a front-facing photo where your face is visible, sharp, and not covered by shadows, filters, sunglasses, or extreme angles. 2 Review Visible Cues The AI reviews lighting, face visibility, expression, balance, proportion, sharpness, and overall photo quality. 3 Read Your Score You receive an attractiveness score, a short interpretation, and photo tips, then you can test another picture. What Can Affect Your Attractiveness Score? An AI face rating is photo-sensitive. These factors can change how attractive the same person appears in a picture. Lighting Quality Soft front light gives the report clearer information. Shadows, backlighting, or low light can hide features and weaken the score. Camera Angle A camera held too high, too low, or too close can distort the face. Eye-level framing gives the AI face rating a clearer view. Expression A relaxed expression helps the test read visible balance. A forced smile, squinting, or unusual pose can change facial cues. Image Sharpness Blur, compression, and poor resolution reduce detail. A sharper photo gives the report better face rating information. Face Visibility Hair, hands, masks, filters, side profiles, and cropped faces make results less useful. A visible full face works best. Styling and Context Hair, glasses, makeup, clothing color, and background contrast affect portrait impressions. The score reflects the uploaded image, not a permanent rating. What Is an Attractiveness Test? An attractiveness test gives structured feedback on how one portrait may be perceived. A Photo-Based Answer to Am I Attractive Many people search for "am I attractive" or "how attractive am I" because they want a simple outside view of a selfie. This photo review gives that answer in a structured way, but it stays tied to the uploaded image. It looks at visible cues such as clarity, lighting, angle, facial balance, expression, and overall portrait quality. The result is not permanent. A different picture can produce a different attractiveness score because photos change how a face is seen. Treat the report as photo feedback first and a beauty score second. What the Score Represents The score estimates visible portrait signals, not identity, worth, confidence, personality, or real-world appeal. Some users call it a pretty scale, beauty score, face rating, or attractiveness score, but it is still photo-based. A useful report explains why the photo received its rating: clear image, even light, centered face, and readable features. The explanation matters because it tells you what to improve in the next photo. How to Get a More Useful Photo Result For a clearer result, improve the photo before you worry about the number. Use Soft, Even Lighting Stand near a window or use gentle front-facing light. Avoid overhead light, colored light, and backlighting because they create shadows. Better light helps the AI review your actual photo. If your first score feels low, retake the photo before judging your face. A clearer selfie often gives a more useful AI face rating. 基于语义的设计、基于字母的变体和图标匹配。 4 我可以以什么格式导出我的Logo？ 目前，Logent AI为所有用户提供PNG格式支持。我们正在积极开发SVG支持和即将更新的其他格式，为您的品牌需求提供更多灵活性。 5 我可以自定义生成的Logo吗？ 是的！您可以自定义Logo的各个方面，包括样式、颜色和格式。我们的AI Logo生成器提供多种变体供您选择和进一步自定义。然而，由于AI图像生成固有的随机性，自定义请求的实现可能会有一些差异。为获得更好的结果，尝试多次生成或升级到我们的专业模型，它提供更高的质量和更好的自定义要求满足度。 6 我可以生成多少种Logo变体？ 变体数量取决于您的订阅计划。入门计划包含基本变体，而专业和企业计划提供更多选项和无限生成。 7 我可以将生成的Logo用于商业目的吗？ 当然可以！使用Logent AI创建的所有Logo都可以用于个人和商业目的。您获得生成Logo的完全使用权，可以将它们用于您的业务、产品、服务或任何其他商业应用，没有限制。 8 Logent AI支持移动设备吗？ 目前，Logent AI通过我们的网站Logent.ai提供服务，在移动浏览器上工作良好。我们正在积极开发专用移动应用程序，为智能手机和平板电脑提供更好的体验。 9 我如何提供反馈或报告问题？ 我们欢迎您的反馈！您可以通过 [email protected] 联系我们的支持团队或访问我们的反馈页面。您的意见帮助我们提供最好的AI Logo生成服务。 10 Logent AI的未来计划是什么？ 我们不断增强我们的AI Logo生成器模型并扩展功能集。我们的路线图包括专用移动应用、高级自定义选项和创新设计工具，为您提供更强大的Logo创建体验。 使用Logent AI创建您的完美Logo 立即开始使用我们的AI Logo生成器创建专业Logo。 开始使用 查看示例 Logent AI Logent AI是一款高级AI Agent Logo生成器，基于您的产品信息自动创建专业Logo。立即生成多种可自定义样式和格式的变体。 关于 特点 展示 © 2025 • Logent AI 保留所有权利。 联系我们 隐私政策 服务条款

Explore Tool → 🌍 Body Fat by Country Compare your BFP to 25 national averages. Explore Tool → Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) What is BFP (Body Fat Percentage)? Body Fat Percentage (BFP) is the proportion of your body weight that consists of fat mass. It's expressed as a percentage and provides a more accurate picture of your health than weight or BMI alone. For example, a BFP of 20% means that 20% of your total body weight is fat. What's the difference between BFP and BMI? BMI (Body Mass Index) only considers height and weight, treating all weight equally. BFP specifically measures fat mass versus lean mass (muscle, bone, organs). An athlete with high muscle mass might have a high BMI but low BFP. BFP provides a much more accurate assessment of body composition and health risks. How do I measure my BFP? extractedText: bilive Skip to content bilive Main Navigation Home Guide Appearance bilive Official documentation 7 x 24 hours unattended recording, rendering danmaku, recognizing subtitles, automatic slicing, automatic uploading, compatible with low-configuration machines, start the project, then everyone can be a recorder. Start now View on GitHub Fast Using pipeline to process videos, the recording and live broadcast difference is half an hour, and the recording can be uploaded before the broadcast ends! Small Occupancy Simultaneously record multiple live broadcasts and danmaku (including normal danmaku, paid danmaku, and gift ship information), and run in a small space. Template No complex configuration, ready to use, (🎉NEW) automatically fetch related popular tags through the bilibili search suggestion interface. (🎉NEW) Automatic slicing upload Calculate the bullet density to find high-energy fragments and slice them, combine the multi-modal video understanding model GLM-4V-PLUS to automatically generate interesting slice titles and content, and upload them. Multi-mode In addition to the pipeline mode, it also supports append and merge modes, and can automatically detect and merge video streams that are segmented due to network issues or live connection issues. Fine-tune rendering danmaku Automatically convert xml to ass danmaku file and render it to the video to form a video with danmaku, and upload it automatically. There are fine-tune rendering parameters for different video resolutions. Low hardware requirements Even without a GPU, you can complete the recording, danmaku rendering, and uploading process with the most basic single-core CPU and the lowest memory, and there is no minimum configuration requirement. 10-year-old computers or servers can still be used! (🎉NEW) Automatic rendering subtitles (requires Nvidia GPU) Use the open-source model whisper from OpenAI to automatically recognize the audio in the video and convert it to subtitles and render it to the video.

），以及一个统一的启动界面（ main.py ）。所有程序都采用现代化的界面设计，提供流畅的用户体验。 主程序 (main.py) 功能特点 统一的启动界面 深色主题设计 简洁的按钮布局 直观的程序选择 支持同时运行多个程序 使用方法 运行主程序： python main.py 界面操作： 点击"动态照片墙"按钮启动照片墙程序 点击"动态视频墙"按钮启动视频墙程序 可以同时运行两个程序 动态照片墙 (Photos.py) 功能特点 支持选择任意文件夹作为图片源 灵活的显示布局： 支持1、2、4、9张图片同时显示 自动调整图片大小和位置 自动切换功能： 支持1-10秒的切换间隔 随机选择图片展示 支持常见图片格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、GIF、BMP 智能加载： 批量加载图片 内存优化的缓存系统 支持子文件夹递归扫描 界面特点： 深色主题设计 简洁的控制面板 流畅的切换动画 使用方法 运行程序： python Photos.py 界面操作： 点击"选择文件夹"按钮选择图片目录 使用"数量"滑块调整显示的图片数量（1/2/4/9张） 使用"间隔"滑块调整自动切换的时间（1-10秒） 动态视频墙 (Videos.py) 功能特点 支持选择任意文件夹作为视频源 2x2 网格布局，同时播放4个视频 支持常见视频格式：MP4、AVI、MKV、MOV 视频控制功能： 进度条显示和拖动控制 显示当前播放时间和总时长 鼠标悬停时显示控制界面 视频管理功能： 右上角删除按钮（鼠标悬停时显示） 删除后自动播放下一个视频 视频播放完成后自动切换到下一个 界面特点： 深色主题设计 简洁美观的用户界面 流畅的动画效果 使用方法 运行程序： python Videos.py 视频控制： 将鼠标移到视频上方显示控制界面 拖动进度条调整播放进度 查看当前播放时间和总时长 将鼠标移到视频右上角可看到删除按钮 安装步骤 确保已安装Python 3.6或更高版本 安装依赖包： pip install -r requirements.txt 系统要求 操作系统：Windows/Linux/MacOS Python版本：3.6或更高 依赖包： PyQt6：用于图形界面 OpenCV (cv2)：用于视频处理（仅视频墙需要） 注意事项 主程序 支持多程序同时运行 界面风格统一 操作简单直观 动态照片墙 图片会自动等比例缩放以适应显示区域 支持大量图片的智能加载和缓存 更改显示数量或时间间隔会立即生效 支持文件夹递归扫描 动态视频墙 视频会自动等比例缩放以适应显示区域 程序会随机选择文件夹中的视频进行播放 删除视频操作不可撤销，请谨慎操作 支持视频拖动播放，方便快速预览 界面元素会自动隐藏，移动鼠标到视频上方可显示 About 动态展示照片/视频，便于演示 A Yes or No Tarot reading is a simple tarot reading designed to answer a specific question with a Yes or No result. headings: Hurricane Simulator: Meteorological Disaster Simulation Game
How to Use the Hurricane Simulator
extractedText: Hurricane Simulator - Experience Nature's Power Online Hurricane Simulator: Meteorological Disaster Simulation Game In the Hurricane Simulator, You can simulate hurricanes in different months and climates, observing their paths, duration, and the damage they cause. Experience realistic hurricane simulation through your browser without any downloads, and explore the power of nature. ✨ Try Nano Banana ✨ How to Use the Hurricane Simulator Launch the Simulator Click the 'green flag' button to enter the game and get familiar with the interface and rules. Water Temperature: Dark Blue=Cold, Blue=Moderate, Light Blue=Warm, Very Bright Blue=Very Warm. Land: Bright Green=Low lying land, Green=High lying land, Dark Green=Mountains. Create Your First Hurricane Click the 'Start' button to create a hurricane. Press 'X' to delete the old storm tracks. You can press the spacebar to change the month, with different months having different water temperatures. The warmer the water, the stronger storms could get. The colder the water, the weaker storms can get. Warmest month: September, Coldest month: March Observe Hurricane Development Closely monitor changes in hurricane intensity, path direction, and impact on land. Experience the effects of hurricanes in different months and along various paths, and feel the incredible power of nature! Features of Hurricane Simulator 🌀 Realistic Hurricane Simulation Experience the authentic process of hurricane formation and development. Hurricane Simulator brings the power of nature to your screen, allowing you to deeply understand this powerful meteorological phenomenon. 📊 In-Depth Meteorological Analysis Hurricane Simulator is more than just observing hurricanes. Analyze meteorological data, develop forecasting strategies, assess potential risks, and experience the challenge of becoming a top hurricane forecaster. 🎛️ Rich Customization Options In Hurricane Simulator, you can freely set various parameters. Choose different ocean temperatures, pressure systems, and terrains to create unique hurricane scenarios. 🌐 Browser-Based Gaming Experience No download required! Hurricane Simulator runs smoothly in your browser, allowing you to experience amazing meteorological simulations anytime, anywhere. Frequently Asked Questions Is Hurricane Simulator free? Absolutely free! You can experience the full version of Hurricane Simulator directly in your browser at no cost. No hidden fees, no in-game purchases required. How realistic is the simulation in Hurricane Simulator? Hurricane Simulator strives to balance realism and entertainment. While it simplifies some complex meteorological processes, it provides a genuine simulation of hurricane formation, development, and impact. Can I save my progress in Hurricane Simulator? Currently, Hurricane Simulator doesn't require login, so progress can't be saved between sessions. We're considering adding this feature in future updates to enhance your experience. How often is Hurricane Simulator updated? We're committed to continuously improving Hurricane Simulator. We regularly release new features, challenges, and improvements. Check our 'What's New' section to stay updated on the latest Hurricane Simulator enhancements! Can I use Hurricane Simulator on my mobile device? Absolutely! Hurricane Simulator uses responsive design, allowing you to experience it on various devices, from desktop computers to tablets and smartphones. About Hurricane Simulator Hurricane Simulator is a free online game that lets you experience the entire process of managing and predicting hurricanes. You can observe the formation, development, and dissipation of hurricanes, predict their paths, and assess their potential impacts. This game is easy to learn and play, suitable for both solo experience and discussion with friends. You can also switch the game interface to your preferred language. headings: Answer these questions to find your true love:
Do you want others to make money with your code?
Do you want others to be able to modify your code?

Will your software be provided as a network service?

extractedText: Open Source License Chooser - Find Your Perfect License Open Source License Chooser Home License Comparison License Usage Chart Toggle theme Toggle language Answer these questions to find your true love: Do you want others to make money with your code? Sure, let them get rich while I eat instant noodles! 💰🍜 No way, my code is for changing the world, not for others to get fat! 😇 Uh... I'm still deciding if I want to be a code philanthropist or a starving artist 🤔 Do you want others to be able to modify your code? Yes, let's collaborate and create something awesome! 🤝 No, my code is perfect as it is 😎 I'm on the fence about this one 🧐 Are you worried about patent trolls? Yes, those trolls give me nightmares 😱 Nah, I'll fight them with my keyboard ⌨️ What's a patent troll? 🤷‍♂️ Will your software be provided as a network service? Yes, I'm going to rule the internet! 🌐 No, my software is shy and doesn't like to go out 🏠 Maybe, it depends on the mood 🎭 Do you care about compatibility with other open source projects? Absolutely, I want to be friends with everyone 🤗 No, my project is the universe 🌌 It depends, I can have friends but not too many 🤔 Clear All Selections Recommended Licenses for You: ( 0 / 15 ) MIT License A short and simple permissive license with conditions only requiring preservation of copyright and license notices. title: Liusha — serverless functions that flow like sand
description: Liusha deploys your function with one command — autoscaling under load, settling to zero when idle. Your own URL, automatic HTTPS, no servers to manage.
headings: Zero to a live URL in three commands
Everything after deploy is our problem
extractedText: Liusha — serverless functions that flow like sand Liusha Features Docs Templates Pricing Sign in Get started Serverless functions · scale to zero Functions that flow like sand. Deploy a function in your language with one command. It autoscales when traffic surges, settles to zero when things go quiet, and costs nothing while it sleeps. Liusha means flowing sand — that’s the whole idea. Deploy your first function Read the quickstart ✓ Scale to zero ✓ Free unlimited egress ✓ No per-request fees $ npm install -g @liusha-com/cli ~/hello $ liusha deploy Packaging source… 12 kB Building in the cloud… 41s Releasing revision hello-00007… 3s ✓ Deployed → https://hello.liusha.app Scaled to zero. Wakes on the first request. The speedrun Zero to a live URL in three commands step 1 Install the CLI One package, no config files, no YAML. $ npm install -g @liusha-com/cli step 2 Start from a template Pick Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP or Rust. $ liusha init hello --template python step 3 Ship it Built in the cloud, live on your own URL. $ liusha deploy What you get Everything after deploy is our problem Scale to zero No requests means no running containers — and no bill. Your function sleeps like settled sand and wakes on the first request. Autoscaling that watches requests Replicas scale with in-flight requests, not CPU guesswork. A traffic spike just means more sand flows. Instant rollbacks Every deploy is an immutable revision. Roll back to any previous one, or split traffic between two revisions for a canary. Your own URL, HTTPS included Every function gets https://name.liusha.app the moment it deploys. Certificates are issued and renewed for you. Live logs and metrics Stream logs as they happen. Watch invocations, latency and cold starts per revision, right from the CLI or console. Built for teams Organizations, projects and scoped API keys. Give your CI a deploy-only token and keep production access tight. Under the hood Open standards. Nothing to unlearn, nowhere you’re locked in. Liusha stays out of your code. Write a standard HTTP server and it stays portable — your function runs anywhere containers and Buildpacks run. No SDK, no lock-in Your function is a plain HTTP server. No proprietary APIs to import, no framework to learn, nothing to rewrite if you ever leave. Isolated by design Every project runs in its own isolated environment with hard resource and network boundaries. Noisy neighbors are never your problem. Ops handled for you Builds, TLS certificates, routing, scaling, rollbacks and log collection are managed around the clock. You only ship code. Your first deploy takes about a minute. A generous free monthly allowance, per-second pricing on CPU and memory, and bandwidth that’s always free. No credit card, no cluster, no YAML. Get started free See pricing Liusha flowing sand Hand your function to the sand. It wakes when traffic arrives and settles back to zero when it leaves. extractedText: DNS.fish - Free online DNS Record Lookup Tool DNS.fish Blog English 简体中文 日本語 Español Français Deutsch DNS.fish $ Quick DNS Record Lookup Tool_ > Live DNS Lookup All A AAAA CNAME MX NS TXT PTR SOA SRV Lookup 👆 Enter a domain name to get DNS records Records Raw > Domain DNS Lookup API Usage $ Get all DNS records: curl dns.fish/DOMAIN $ Get specific type records: curl dns.fish/DOMAIN/TYPE Replace DOMAIN with target domain, TYPE with DNS record type (A, AAAA, MX, etc.). > Features Fast Lookups • Fast and live DNS record lookups All Record Types • All common DNS record types supported API Support • Zero install, supports CLI(API) usage Blazing Fast • Blazing fast response times Clean Output • Clean, parsable output Export Options • Export & Download DNS records > FAQ Q: What is a DNS record? A: A DNS record is a database entry in the Domain Name System that maps a domain name to specific information, such as IP addresses or other data related to the domain. Q: Why is it important to check DNS records? A: Checking DNS records is crucial for several reasons: Troubleshooting: Helps identify and resolve website accessibility issues Security: Verifies proper configuration to prevent DNS-based attacks Email delivery: Ensures correct MX records for smooth email flow Performance: Confirms optimal DNS settings for fast website loading Migrations: Validates DNS changes during website or server migrations Compliance: Assists in maintaining required security standards Regular DNS record checks help maintain a healthy, secure, and efficient online presence. Q: What are the most common types of DNS records? A: The most common types of DNS records include: A (Address) record: Maps a domain to an IPv4 address AAAA record: Maps a domain to an IPv6 address CNAME (Canonical Name) record: Aliases one domain to another MX (Mail Exchanger) record: Specifies mail servers for the domain TXT (Text) record: Stores text-based information, often used for SPF, DKIM, etc. NS (Name Server) record: Specifies authoritative name servers for the domain Q: What is the difference between A and AAAA records? A: A records map a domain to an IPv4 address (e.g., 192.0.2.1), while AAAA records map a domain to an IPv6 address (e.g., 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334). Q: What is a CNAME record used for? A: A CNAME record is used to create an alias for a domain. It points one domain name to another, allowing multiple domains to resolve to the same IP address without duplicate A or AAAA records. Q: How do MX records work? A: MX records specify the mail servers responsible for handling email for a domain. They include a priority value to determine the order in which mail servers should be tried. Q: What is a TTL in DNS records? A: TTL stands for Time To Live. title: Query.Domains: Instant Free Bulk Domain Availability Checker - Based on WHOIS Lookup
description: Free Tool for Bulk check domain availability, get instant whois query results. Bulk Whois checking API is supported.
extractedText: Query.Domains: Instant Free Bulk Domain Availability Checker - Based on WHOIS Lookup Query.Domains API Pricing More Pricing Fast Accurate Detailed Instant Bulk Domain Availability Checker Support 1000+ TLDs, instant results Our Advantages Making domain search simpler and more efficient Lightning Fast Get instant results with our optimized domain checking system Highly Accurate Real-time WHOIS data with 99.9% accuracy guarantee Detailed Info Comprehensive domain information including pricing and history Bulk Support Check thousands of domains at once with our bulk processing API Access Developer-friendly API for seamless integration Privacy Protected We respect your privacy and never share your search data Trusted by Users Worldwide Join thousands of users who rely on our domain checking service 10M+ Domains Checked 1K+ Active Users 1000+ TLDs Supported Frequently Asked Questions Everything you need to know about our domain checking service What is Query.Domains? Query.Domains is a free bulk WHOIS checker tool for checking domain availability based on WHOIS lookups. Our service provides fast, accurate, and detailed results for your domain queries and bulk WHOIS checks. How does Query.Domains work? Why does it seem so fast? Our service allows you to enter keywords or domain names. We perform DNS lookups and bulk WHOIS lookups to check their availability. Using SSE, we return the data swiftly, providing instant results for multiple domains at once, making it an efficient bulk domain availability checker. Is Query.Domains free to use? Yes, Query.Domains offers a free plan for bulk domain availability checks and WHOIS lookups. However, we're excited to announce that we'll be launching a Pro plan soon, which will offer expanded capabilities, including a higher limit on bulk checks and additional features. Stay tuned for more details on our upcoming Pro plan! How many TLDs can be checked simultaneously for the same keyword? Currently, you can check up to 20 TLDs simultaneously. This can be customized using the options on the right side of the keyword input box. How many domains can I check at once? [Coming soon] In the scenario where you upload your own list of domains: We're working on expanding our bulk WHOIS checking capabilities. In the near future, free users will be able to check up to 1,000 domains at once. For our Pro users, we're planning to offer the ability to check up to 10,000 domains in a single batch. Stay tuned for updates on our bulk domain lookup features! Do you cache WHOIS query results? Yes, we cache WHOIS query results to speed up future requests. This allows us to provide faster responses for repeated bulk WHOIS lookups. Does Query.Domains support RDAP queries for WHOIS information? Yes, we will soon prioritize using RDAP (Registration Data Access Protocol) queries for WHOIS information and display it accordingly. You can use our RDAP query tool ReWhois for that. How do you use the data from my searches? We use the data solely to provide and improve our bulk WHOIS lookup service. We do not sell the data or use it for domain registration purposes. Do you provide an API for bulk WHOIS checking? Yes, we offer an API for bulk WHOIS checking and domain availability lookups. For more information on how to use our bulk WHOIS lookup API, please contact us. How accurate is the domain availability information? While we strive for high accuracy in our bulk domain availability checks, the availability status shown is based on the most recent WHOIS data we have. For the most up-to-date information, we recommend double-checking with a domain registrar. If a domain shows as available, does it mean I can register it? Not necessarily. While our bulk WHOIS lookup service provides information on domain availability based on WHOIS data, the final determination of whether a domain can be registered depends on the domain registrar. The availability status you see on Query.Domains is a good indicator, but it's always best to confirm

JS 脚本支持：使用 JavaScript 创建自定义规则，扩展抓包体验，实现个性化分析逻辑。 5. 请求重放：一键重发已捕获请求，模拟不同网络场景，观察应用响应行为，优化调试与测试流程。 6. 请求/响应重写：灵活修改请求与响应的 Header 或 Body，实现对数据交互的精细化控制。 7. 客户端代理：将局域网内其他设备的网络请求转发至本设备，集中调试更高效。 8. 服务器代理支持：将 HTTP 请求转发至指定代理服务器，满足高级代理链路或企业网络测试需求。 9. 桌面小组件 & 灵动岛支持：支持在灵动岛显示实时上传/下载速率与流量使用情况，网络状态一目了然。 权限说明： 启动 Network Sniffer 需要获得你的 VPN 授权。该授权仅用于本地数据捕获，不涉及任何远程代理或数据转发。 隐私声明： Network Sniffer 亲属是基于婚姻、血缘和法律拟制而形成的社会关系。亲属关系包括夫妻、父母、子女、兄弟姊妹、祖父母和外祖父母、孙子女和外孙子女、儿媳和公婆、女婿和岳父母、以及其他三代以内的旁系血亲，如伯、叔、姑、舅、姨、侄子女、甥子女、堂兄弟姊妹、表兄弟姊妹、姨兄弟姊妹等。 亲属称谓指是以本人为中心确定亲族成员和本人关系的名称，是基于血亲姻亲基础上的亲属之间相互称呼的名称、叫法。汉族的家族亲属关系条理分明尊卑有序：比自己长一辈的称呼有姨姑舅叔伯，同辈的有兄弟姊妹、堂表亲等等，下一辈有甥侄等等。中国人由于姻亲而产生的亲戚关系相当庞杂，“祖宗十八代”、“五服”、“六亲”、“九族”让人难以区分，其派生出的各种称谓也是中华文化的一大特征。 如今由于工作生活节奏差异，很多关系稍疏远的亲戚之间来往并不多，年龄差异长幼辈分模糊。春节拜年走亲戚遇到七大姑八大姨，往往会搞不清楚哪位亲戚应该喊什么称呼，很是尴尬。不仅小孩搞不清亲戚关系和亲戚称谓，就连年轻一代的大人也都常常模糊混乱。 “中国亲戚关系计算器”为你避免了叫错、不会叫亲戚的尴尬，收录了中国亲戚关系称呼大全，只需简单的输入即可完成称呼计算。称呼计算器同时兼容了不同地域的方言叫法，你可以称呼父亲为：“老爸”、“爹地”、“老爷子”等等。让您准确的叫出亲戚称谓，理清亲属之间的亲戚关系，轻松掌握中国式的亲戚关系换算，让你更了解中国文化。 算法开源
